why:
issue 2024 (2026-10-25) -- LANDED on a HOSTED build: the owning handle `ParameterEventHandler::add_parameter_event_callback` returns, `ParameterEventCallbackHandle::SharedPtr` = `std::shared_ptr<ParameterEventCallbackHandle>`; dropping every copy unregisters, as upstream's does. THE BOUND: it has no public `callback` member. The callback is a heap `std::function<void(const uint8_t*, size_t)>` over the CDR frame behind a private pointer -- type-erased because without runtime typesupport this header cannot name `rcl_interfaces::msg::ParameterEvent` (the handler wraps the user's typed callback in it), and behind a pointer so the type has one layout on every build (`check-cpp-capability-layout`). Hosted only, with the handler (no allocator on a freestanding build). See `cpp:ParameterEventHandler`.
